id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the Gantt chart.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

defaultColors.description:
A list of default colors.
If a series doesn't have specified color it will take color from here in order.

data.description: Holds the data to display in the Gantt chart.

xAxis.description: The xAxis configuration for this Gantt chart that determines the start/end date.

yAxisName.description: The yAxis name for this Gantt chart.

puckLabelHorizontalAlignment.description: Horizontal label alignment on a puck.

puckLabelVerticalAlignment.description: Vertical label alignment on a puck.

tooltipDecimalPrecision.description: The decimal precision to show on the puck tooltips.

showLineage.description: Set this field value when "Show Lineage" or "Hide Lineage" is selected.

multiSelectMode.description: Whether the user has entered multi-select mode.

saveDataOnDrop.description: Whether data should be automatically saved on puck drop.

showStacking.description: Whether overlapped pucks should be stacking.

mouseTracking.description: Whether the cursor tracking line should be shown.

showYaxisGridLine.description: Whether to show the y-axis grid line.

hideEmptyTooltipValue.description: Whether to hide empty tooltip value (i.e. a line with just tooltip label).

exportInLocalTime.description: If set to false UTC time will be shown in the exported CSV.

fixedContainerHeight.description:
Sets a specific height (in pixels) for the Gantt chart container. If set, and the Gantt chart height exceeds the
value in this field, the chart will be scrollable.

puckDeemphasizedColor.description:
When in "show dependencies" state, only the selected puck and any dependencies should be shown in their normal
color state.  All other pucks should be de-emphasized.

unionPuckColor.description: Color string for union pucks (i.e. union of overlapping pucks).

chartActionsCollapseThreshold.description:
The number of chart actions to display on the grid header. If there are more, an additional chart action
icon is displayed, and the extra actions are displayed under a dropdown triggered by clicking the additional
chart action.

Chart actions that are configured outside of the {@link chartActions} field do not count towards this limit.
The additional chart action itself does count towards the limit. Examples:

- If chartActionsCollapseThreshold is set to 2 and there are two actions, both of them are shown on the
  chart header, and there is no additional actions icon.
- If chartActionsCollapseThreshold is set to 2 and there are three actions - "A", "B", and "C" - the
  chart header will show action "A" and the additional actions icon.  Clicking the additional actions icon
  will show a dropdown containing actions "B" and "C".

chartActions.description:
The set of actions that don't depend on a selected puck, e.g., export, refresh. A toggleable group of actions can
also be specified. When considering the `chartActionsCollapseThreshold`, consider the chart actions to be
flattened. Listen to triggers of the chart actions through `CHART_ACTION_CLICK_${actionSuffix}`.

multiplePuckActionsCollapseThreshold.description:
The number of puck actions to display on the chart header.
Similar logic to `chartActionsCollapseThreshold`. See the other field for details.

puckActionType.description:
The action type for the selected puck.
This field is used with {@link multiplePuckActions} to display the puck actions.

multiplePuckActions.description:
The set of actions that apply to pucks.
Those actions will be visible only if at least one puck has been selected.
Listen to triggers of the puck actions through `MULTIPLE_PUCK_ACTION_CLICK_${actionSuffix}`.
The key must be the same as `puckActionType` field on puck type. 'default' is
used for null/undefined `puckActionType` field.

expandedRowIds.description: Currently expanded row ids. Used for overlapping/union pucks feature.

expandedParentRowIds.description:
Currently expanded row ids of parent pucks.
This is used to expand a parent puck to reveal its child pucks.

immovablePuckLegendLabel.description: Legend label for immovable pucks (locked, or overtime/downtime pucks).

title: `UiGanttChart` is a component focused on visualizing a Gantt chart.
name: UiGanttChart
